line: If another desk changes a record while your form is open, saving now tells you instead of overwriting it.
Home lists accepted referrals with no bed pulled, and Pull the bed now takes two taps in one sheet.
Weekly report shows the four agreed pilot measures. Forms 3B and 3C read differently. Incoming beds say pulled.
Skip tour now closes the tour and marks it as seen. You can open it again from Help.
Moving someone from a locked to an open bed asks for a reason when needed. Extending a form needs the new expiry date.
Recording a departure asks where they went, with nothing chosen for you. Pulling a bed names who it was pulled for.
Where nothing is recorded the screens say so, and the referral summary labels what came from the referral letter.
Phone ED rows show the UMRN beside the name. The practice hospital feed names each person and a confirm can be undone.
Handover keeps your shift past midnight, the forecast covers long weekends, and an ED accept needs two separate taps.
Confirm arrival now asks you to check the name and UMRN first. A refusal shows as a warning, never a tick.
Sign-in screens now say Ward Flow for every role, and explain why some desks are not listed.
Broadcast alert is greyed out for desks that cannot send one, and admins cannot remove their own admin role.
A transport officer whose role names no health service is told to ask for it again with one.
Handover offers only your own wards and places, and Beds totals count your wards only.
The ward Referral inbox now shows the referral number.
After a refresh, if loading your saved board closed something you had just opened, the notice now says so.
Referrals can mark the medication or observation chart To follow when it is not to hand.
Transport bookings use one form on every screen, with legal status filled in from Legal now.
Screens now say Bed coordinator, pulled for incoming beds, and plain words in place of codes.
The ED Ask for a bed form keeps every answer when you choose quickly on a phone.
